title: pm daily scratchpad 2026-03-12
content:
2026-03-12 PM SCRATCHPAD - Aisha Kapoor

Morning quick notes:
- slept poorly, low bandwidth but need to keep launch momentum
- focus: adaptive-batching PRD edits, sync w/ infra on perf numbers, finalize launch checklist items for beta customers

Timeboxed plan:
- 9:00-9:30: triage and inbox (Jira + GH reviews)
- 9:30-10:00: standup + follow-ups w/ Carlos (infra) re: perf baseline
- 10:15-11:00: PRD edit pass (see TODOs below)
- 11:15-12:00: stakeholder sync (Priya, SRE, Eng)
- afternoon: customer comms + rollout runbook updates

PRD edits to complete (Adaptive Batching feature):
- Clarify latency SLO targets: add 95th and 99th pct for small/med/large seq-lengths (action: ask SRE for historical percentiles, Carlos)
- Add explicit fallback policy when batch queue depth > X: degrade to smaller-quantized model variant + emit metric "batch_fallback_reason"
- Update API contract section: new batching hint header (X-Batch-Priority) - include examples for curl and SDK
- Add rollout proposal: canary to 10% traffic -> 25% -> 50% with automated rollback on quality/regression alert (linked to QA eval harness)
- Performance table: insert latency/cost delta numbers from infra perf test (pending Carlos numbers RDEV-4599)

Follow-ups / action items:
- @Carlos: get perf test CSV and 95/99 pct numbers by EOD today (JIRA RDEV-4599) -> blocking PRD perf table
- @Priya: confirm customer beta list + NDA status; need final list for targeted launch email by 3/15
- @Ethan (DX): update SDK example for batching hint; small PR to include in SDK 0.12.1
- @Legal (cc): quick check on telemetry wording in PRD (we send aggregated batch metrics; ensure not PII)

Launch checklist (beta):
- [ ] PRD final review + signoff (product + eng + SRE) -> aim 3/13
- [ ] Perf verification run on Dedicated env (SRE + infra) -> 3/12
- [ ] SDK + docs update merged -> 3/14
- [ ] Console dashboard: add per-route batching metrics + alert thresholds -> 3/14
- [ ] Rollout playbook in ops-runbooks repo -> 3/15
- [ ] Customer comms draft for beta -> 3/15
- [ ] Support runbook + triage flow + escalation contacts -> 3/15

Risks / blockers:
- Perf numbers still pending from infra; without these we can't finalize cost/latency tradeoffs for default config
- QA eval harness needs one more test set for regression detection on small prompt distributions (Priya to own)
- Potential SDK breaking change if header naming collides w/ existing headers (talk to Ethan before merging)

Notes to self / questions:
- Do we need a migration plan for customers with pinned model versions? Probably yes — include a small section in rollout playbook.
- Consider adding an experiment flag in Dedicated to toggle batching behavior per-customer (ask infra/eng)
- Keep default batch_max_size conservative until we have more perf data

Quick links (for me):
- PRD draft: CONFLUENCE: PRD-Adaptive-Batching-2026
- Perf ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDEV-4599
- SDK PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/122

Meeting notes snippets:
- Standup: Carlos: infra test run started, hitting OOM at batch_size 1024 on v2 nodes -> investigating quantization path. Priya: customer list almost final; two legal NDAs pending; Ethan: SDK change is small, but needs E2E test where header round-trips through proxy.
- Stakeholder sync: agreed to ship PRD with TODO perf numbers pinned as placeholders; must attach perf CSV in PRD before signoff.

End-of-day reflection:
- Got PRD structure cleaned up but still need perf numbers. Prioritize follow-up with Carlos first thing. Keep checklist visible in Confluence and link to runbook.

Unresolved questions to add to PRD comments:
- exact threshold values for automatic fallback (queue depth / latency) -> TBD after perf data
- telemetry retention policy for batch-level metrics (SRE/legal)

Random TODOs (personal):
- reply to recruiting email about PM candidate for infra PM role
- add time off block for 2026-04-02 to calendar
_notes_internal: scratchpad style: informal, lots of TODOs and ticket refs; should be saved to Confluence when cleaned up.
